subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw TUI own a default-off completion notifier, and which modes should be supported first: terminal bell only, desktop notification, configurable sound, or no core notifier?
rationale: The request is useful but it adds user-facing behavior, platform integration, and new config keys rather than fixing an established contract, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Design a narrow default-off TUI notifier
options.body: Adopt the request as a TUI-owned feature, start with a small mode set, and require config/docs/PTI-local and Gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Keep TUI visual-only for now
options.body: Leave completion feedback as final message plus status line and direct users to existing tasks/node notification surfaces for external alerts.

options.title: Defer behind broader alerting design
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation on the gateway watchdog and operator alert direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39141.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow default-off TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Adopt the request as a TUI-owned feature, start with a small mode set, and require config/docs/PTI-local and Gateway proof before merge.
